Config.Description: One local web app and JSON API for visual AI: text-to-image (Qwen-Image 2.1 or Krea 2 Turbo), photo editing, masked inpainting, uncropping and video (Wan 2.2) with GGUF models, driving a running ComfyUI backend.
Config.Example: a watercolour lighthouse on a rocky coast at dusk

Functionalities.Name: Text-to-image generation
Functionalities.Description: Enter a prompt and parameters (resolution, steps, CFG, seed, batch) and the server queues the Qwen-Image 2.1 GGUF workflow on ComfyUI, waits for the render and returns the images in the browser and to the output/ directory.

Functionalities.Name: Model and quantization switching
Functionalities.Description: Pick any published GGUF quantization (Q4_0 through BF16) and either text encoder (int8 or bf16) per request without editing the workflow.

Functionalities.Name: Photo editing
Functionalities.Description: Upload a photo and describe the change; the base model edits it natively using the photo as a reference image (POST /api/edit).

Functionalities.Name: Inpainting
Functionalities.Description: Paint a mask over part of a photo and regenerate only that area; pixels outside the mask are kept exactly (POST /api/inpaint).

Functionalities.Name: Uncrop
Functionalities.Description: Extend a photo beyond its borders to a chosen aspect ratio or zoom-out; only the new border is generated and the original pixels are kept (POST /api/inpaint with a padded image).

Functionalities.Name: Video
Functionalities.Description: Text-to-video, or bring a photo to life: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B renders 2-5 s at 24 fps, sized to the photo's shape (POST /api/video).

Functionalities.Name: Prompt enhancer
Functionalities.Description: Rewrite a short prompt into a detailed one with a local LLM served by Ollama (POST /api/enhance).

Functionalities.Name: Job queue, progress and cancel
Functionalities.Description: Queue as many jobs as you like; each shows its queue position, live sampler-step progress and its own Cancel (GET /api/progress, POST /api/cancel).

Functionalities.Name: JSON API
Functionalities.Description: POST /api/generate, /api/edit, /api/inpaint and /api/video to script generation; GET /api/health reports whether the ComfyUI backend is reachable.

Functionalities.Name: LoRA
Functionalities.Description: Stack a LoRA with adjustable strength on any mode (GET /api/loras lists what ComfyUI can see).
